title: Harees with Eastern Flair
description: A traditional Middle Eastern dish made with wheat and harees, flavored with a hint of zesty spices.
instructions: Rinse the harees in a fine mesh strainer and soak it in water for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Drain and rinse the harees, then transfer it to a large pot.
Add the wheat, water, zesty spice blend, olive oil, onion, garlic, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Check the harees for tenderness by inserting a fork or knife; if it's still firm, continue to cook for another 10-15 minutes.
Once the harees is tender, remove it from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Serve the harees warm, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
